configuration.boundary: planning, submission, runtime Row source, keyed state, both row/Arrow transposes and blackhole row sink; cluster setup and initial explain excluded
configuration.schedule: alternating stock/native per JVM; separate JVMs per cardinality and phase; no concurrent tests, builds or benchmarks during measurements

cpu_profiles.boundary: one unprofiled native-only complete-job warmup; profile native-only jobs until the8second target completes, including planning/compilation/allJVMthreads; stop after currentjob
cpu_profiles.limitations: inclusive counts overlap; not allocation counts/copied bytes, and profiled times do not enter trial tables

scope.admitted: INT/BIGINT COLLECT in synchronous single-phase grouping with scalar inputs and non-character output fields; DISTINCT/FILTER/global forms and verified final row-sink/fused Calc

conclusion: Native medians beat paired stock but exceed prior fallback; ranges overlap and jobs are short. No sustained acceleration claim. Two profiling/optimization passes found grouped processing, map snapshots, output writing and startup costs; no safe small optimization was identified. Accepted bounded collection tradeoff; further performance work belongs to the native SQL backlog#239.
